description: Interactive Owner questions must not pay ~39s DeepSeek latency without justification.

measuredEvidence.note: Measured under Claude daily-intelligence work; numbers are acceptance oracles, not product hardcodes.

interactiveQuestions: How many other used cars are on the lot?
Is this a good match for Sarah?
complexOrBackgroundOkForReasoning: Compare several customers and vehicles and draft a prioritization with tradeoffs
Background synthesis of archive themes when Owner requests deep review

failIf: normal lot-walk interactive path always uses reasoning model with ~39s class latency
routing policy claims REASONING_LOCAL for pure lot-scope / price referent without synthesis need
UI shows long silent wait with no progress while reasoning model runs on simple question
passIf: interactive goals prefer DETERMINISTIC or FAST_LOCAL when available
REASONING_LOCAL reserved for synthesis/planning goals or explicit Owner ask
when reasoning is used, progress/status is truthful and latency is expected

judgeAgainst: measured routing policy + Owner UX, not an invented millisecond SLA
